          Terms of Service

          The whole agreement, in plain language — including exactly how DFW Job Bid makes money. Last updated October 25, 2026.

          The service

          DFW Job Bid is a platform where homeowners post work they need done, and handymen and companies (“pros”) respond with bids. Homeowners post a job — photos, a description, and their area — with either a stated price or a request for quotes. Pros may like a post or submit a bid; private contact with a homeowner through the platform opens only for the pro whose bid that homeowner accepts. DFW Job Bid is a marketplace connector only: the work contract is between the homeowner and the pro. Bearden Business Solutions, which operates DFW Job Bid, is not a party to that work, does not perform it, and does not guarantee its quality or completion.

          Accounts

          • You must create an account to post a job or bid. Keep your information accurate and your login private.
          • One person or business per account. Pros are responsible for the work and conduct of anyone they send to a job.

          How DFW Job Bid makes money

          • Homeowners: posting jobs is free.
          • Pros: a $10.00 per month subscription is required to bid and receive private inquiries. The subscription renews monthly until cancelled; cancelling stops future renewals, and bidding access runs to the end of the paid month.
          • Platform fee: on a job awarded through the platform, the pro pays a service fee of 1.7% of the winning bid amount. Example: a $1,000 winning bid carries a $17.00 platform fee. The fee is earned when the bid is accepted and is non-refundable once the job is awarded through the platform.

          Taxes may apply to fees where required by law. Fee amounts may change with notice posted in these terms before the change takes effect.

          Posting and bidding rules

          • Post only work you genuinely need done, in the area where the work is. Photos and descriptions must be yours and accurate.
          • Bids must be real offers you intend to honor. No bait pricing, no spam, no posting the same job repeatedly.
          • Negotiations happen in private messages through the platform — not in public comments.
          • Ratings and reviews must reflect a real job done through the platform and your honest experience. Fake or paid reviews are grounds for removal.

          Areas

          Jobs are posted to a local area, starting with Dallas–Fort Worth and its cities. More areas will be added under the same platform; your account works in every area we serve.

          Conduct and removal

          We may remove posts, bids, reviews, or accounts that break these terms, break the law, or put other users at risk, with or without notice. Users are responsible for verifying any license, insurance, or permit a job requires; DFW Job Bid does not verify licenses unless a profile is explicitly marked as verified by us.

          Liability

          The platform is provided “as is.” To the extent allowed by law, Bearden Business Solutions is not liable for work performed (or not performed) by users, for disputes between homeowners and pros, or for indirect damages arising from use of the platform. Texas law governs these terms.

          Changes

          We may update these terms; the current version will always be posted here, and continued use after an update means you accept it. Questions about these terms: reach us through the DFW Job Bid website — Bearden Business Solutions.

          Privacy Policy

          How DFW Job Bid handles your information, in plain language. Last updated October 25, 2026.

          What we collect

          • Account details: your name, email, phone number if you add one, your area and city, and — for pros — your business name and trade.
          • Photos you upload: profile and cover photos, and photos attached to job posts.
          • Activity: job posts, bids, private messages between homeowners and pros, and ratings and reviews.

          How it's used

          Your information runs the marketplace: showing your posts and profile, delivering bids and private messages to the right person, and keeping pro ratings attached to the right profile. That's it — we don't use it for anything unrelated.

          What's public, what's private

          • Public: job posts, pro profiles, and ratings and reviews.
          • Private: bids and messages are visible only to the homeowner and the pro involved. Your email and phone number are never shown publicly.

          What we don't do

          We don't sell your personal information. Subscription and platform-fee payments are handled by payment processors — we never see or store your full card number.

          Your choices

          You can update your profile details and replace any photo at any time, right from your account. To close your account and remove your information, contact Bearden Business Solutions through the DFW Job Bid website and we'll take care of it.
